statement: Golden MOVE mission for the issue-to-PR loop: move helper() from pkg/core.py to pkg/ops.py. The loop must split/rewrite imports, inject the moved block's dependency closure (from pkg.core import normalize into the target), prove the fixed point by re-index (name defined in target, absent from defining module), select the minimal affected test set, run it green, and emit a diff + pr_intent + receipt, byte-identical on rerun.
